description:
Location Qualifications:
Bucharest (hybrid, 2 days in the office)

About the position

As an AI Engineer at Showpad, you will contribute to our AI and machine learning initiatives, working closely with cross-functional teams to develop and implement AI technologies that align with our business goals. You'll collaborate with experienced engineers to build impactful solutions and grow your expertise in a fast-moving space.

You'll work with state-of-the-art technologies such as LLM models like LLama 3/3.1, Claude models, AWS Bedrock, AWS Sagemaker, and AWS OpenSearch. Our primary languages are Python, TypeScript, and Kotlin. The AI and Generative AI space is evolving rapidly, and so are we — we continuously update to the newest models, track emerging techniques, and engage in extensive experimentation with prompt engineering.



Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain AI models to solve complex business problems
  • Contribute to projects from scoping through to release, under the guidance of senior engineers
  • Support the performance and reliability of AI and machine learning systems
  • Collaborate effectively across teams, sharing progress and surfacing blockers early
  • Design, craft, and optimize prompts that guide our AI systems to generate accurate, informative, and creative outputs
  • Contribute to engineering and product discussions, bringing fresh perspectives.



Are you our next AI Engineer?

Must haves

  • Educational background in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field — or equivalent knowledge gained through hands-on experience
  • Experience developing and implementing AI models and algorithms
  • Good knowledge of Python
  • Hands-on experience working with LLMs and other Generative AI models
  • Experience working with AWS or other cloud providers
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and creatively
  • Good communication and collaboration skills

Nice to haves

  • Experience building retrieval augmented generation (RAG) systems
  • Experience with search algorithms
  • Experience working in an agile team
  • Experience with the evaluation of (Generative) AI systems

 

Company Highlights: 

Welcome to the new era of revenue effectiveness. The merger of Showpad and Bigtincan is creating the first AI-powered platform to strengthen the entire field selling motion.

By unifying two industry-acclaimed solutions for content, readiness, engagement, and intelligence into a single operating system, we are delivering unrivaled scale and accelerated growth for our 2,000+ combined customers worldwide, including leaders in manufacturing (Dow, Dupont), healthcare (Fujifilm, Kaiser Permanente, Johnson&Johnson), CPG (Smucker’s, Mitsubishi, Stanley Black & Decker), and enterprise tech (HID, CultureAmp, LastPass).

Acclaimed by analysts and adored by customers, we’re recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ Revenue Enablement Platforms, honored by Gartner as a Customers’ Choice in Revenue Enablement Platforms, and, together, endorsed by nearly 3,000 5-star customer reviews on G2.

United, we’re focused on powering the next generation of field selling success through a more holistic engine that creates lasting value for our customers and a new vision for our category.

Discover the revenue team outcomes we’re driving together at showpad.com.
